full_judgment: 4. On the other hand defendant No.1 Md. Abdul Matin the predecessor of present petitioner No.1 to 15, contested the suit by filling written statement denying Material allegation made in plaint contending inter alia that the original owners Jyoti Bikash and others admittedly transferred 22 acre of land to Abdur Rahim who dead leaving behind sex sons seven daughter and wife to inherit the same subsequently by amicable partitions his 4(four) daughters Rabiya, Helena Jalalena @ Jalekha and Hasna Banu (defendants Nos. 8 to 11) having got the same transferred it to Md. Abdul Matin (defendant No.1), the predecessor of the petitioner here in by deeds dated 05.11.1979. Defendant No.2, 15 and 16 brothers of the plaintiff and all others tenants attorned and admitted defendant No.1, Abdul Matin as the owner of the suit land and continued raying rents. Thereafter the plaintiff defendant No.2 and others tenants vide argument dated.28.11.1986 continuous paying rents regularly to defended No.1, but suddenly when they stopped paying rents defendant No.1 filled other suit No.18 of 1992, 35 of 1991, and 35 of 1992, agreement them for ejectment and obtained with decree which were upheld up to the High Court Division and appellate Division pursuant to those decree defendant No.1, obtained passions of the Suit property through court, it is further contended out of 22 acre of land in the suit plot No. 2795, 11 acre recorded as government khash land whereupon defendant No.1 upon taking pattan form the Government is possessing the same Accordingly this dependent prayed for dismissing the Suit.
